summary: Four-asset leave-one-out common-factor residual study. The strongest hard-valid exploratory state-exit candidate 021fbab613517a31ad98 produced 194 one-global-slot trades in 2023. After exact official funding cashflows it returned +23.2585%, +16.7170% and +11.2649% at 12/18/24 bps; 12-bps geometric daily growth was 0.0573077%, PF 1.504 and MDD 4.617%. It is closer to the 1% target than the prior first place and is ranking-eligible, but the registered economic gate failed: removing the largest 10% trades changes return to -21.8583%, median trade is negative, and all four frozen 2024 family portfolios lost. No later holdout or order permission was opened.
